description: Curated list of canonical WWI primary sources for the story engine

sources.title: Over the Top
sources.author: Arthur Guy Empey
sources.author_info: American soldier, served with British Army
sources.notes: First-hand account of trench warfare, very popular at the time

sources.title: Gallipoli Diary, Volume I
sources.author: Ian Hamilton
sources.author_info: British General, commanded Mediterranean Expeditionary Force
sources.notes: Daily diary from the commander of the Gallipoli campaign

sources.title: Gallipoli Diary, Volume II
sources.author: Ian Hamilton
sources.author_info: British General, commanded Mediterranean Expeditionary Force

sources.title: A German Deserter's War Experience
sources.author: Anonymous
sources.notes: Rare German enlisted perspective, critical of war

sources.title: Under Fire (Le Feu)
sources.author: Henri Barbusse
sources.notes: Prix Goncourt winner, vivid account of French infantry experience

sources.title: The First Hundred Thousand
sources.author: Ian Hay
sources.author_info: British officer, later became a playwright
sources.notes: Chronicles the training and deployment of Kitchener's New Army

sources.title: Outwitting the Hun: My Escape from a German Prison Camp
sources.author: Pat O'Brien
sources.notes: Exciting escape narrative from a POW camp

sources.title: The Diary of a U-boat Commander
sources.author: Stephen King-Hall
sources.notes: Fictional diary but based on extensive research

sources.title: War Letters of a Public-School Boy
sources.author: Henry Paul Mainwaring Jones
sources.notes: Letters from the front, author died in the war

sources.title: A Student in Arms
sources.author: Donald Hankey
sources.author_info: British soldier and essayist, killed at the Somme
sources.notes: Thoughtful essays on soldier life, author killed at Somme 1916

sources.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
sources.author: Erich Maria Remarque
sources.author_info: German veteran, wrote novel based on experience
sources.notes: Most famous WWI novel, based on author's experience

sources.title: Good-bye to All That
sources.author: Robert Graves
sources.notes: Classic memoir, very quotable, covers Somme extensively

sources.title: Tales from a Dugout
sources.author: Arthur Guy Empey
sources.author_info: American soldier, served with British Army
sources.notes: More stories from the author of Over the Top

sources.title: All in It: K(1) Carries On
sources.author: Ian Hay
sources.notes: Sequel to The First Hundred Thousand

sources.title: Experiences of a Dug-out, 1914-1918
sources.author: C. E. Callwell
sources.notes: Senior officer perspective on the war

sources.title: Four Weeks in the Trenches: The War Story of a Violinist
sources.author: Fritz Kreisler
sources.author_info: Austrian-American violinist, served in Austrian Army
sources.notes: Famous violinist's account of service on Eastern Front

sources.title: The 28th: A Record of War Service
sources.author: Herbert Brayley Collett
sources.notes: Detailed unit history with personal accounts

sources.title: Letters to Helen: Impressions of an Artist on the Western Front
sources.author: Keith Henderson
sources.notes: Artist's perspective on the war

sources.title: The Attack in Trench Warfare
sources.author: André Laffargue
sources.notes: Tactical manual based on experience, influential document

sources.title: The Kaiser's Memoirs
sources.author: Wilhelm II
sources.notes: The German Emperor's own account, important for political context

sources.title: A Hilltop on the Marne
sources.author: Mildred Aldrich
sources.notes: Civilian perspective on the Battle of the Marne from her house overlooking it

sources.title: On the Edge of the War Zone
sources.author: Mildred Aldrich
sources.notes: Continuation of Hilltop on the Marne

sources.title: Two War Years in Constantinople
sources.author: Harry Stuermer
sources.notes: German journalist's critical account of Ottoman alliance

sources.title: Storm of Steel
sources.author: Ernst Jünger
sources.notes: One of the most important WWI memoirs, very detailed combat accounts
